name: Model Profile Cache
description: File-based cache for model register sensitivity profiles with pre-seeded calibration data. Tracks per-model and per-task-type accuracy metrics across different linguistic registers (direct, technical, academic, narrative, casual) to enable register-aware prompt optimization.

types.name: RegisterAccuracy

fields.name: sample_size
fields.description: Number of test cases used for calibration

fields.name: task_type
fields.description: Task type filter; empty string means aggregate across all tasks

types.description: Register-specific accuracy measurement for a model

fields.name: accuracies
fields.description: Accuracy measurements for each register on this task type

types.name: ModelProfile

fields.name: accuracies
fields.description: Aggregate accuracy across all tasks (backward compatible)

fields.name: ttl_hours
fields.description: Time-to-live in hours before profile is considered expired

types.description: Complete calibration profile for a single model including aggregate and per-task register sensitivities

types.name: ProfileCache

fields.name: _cache_dir
fields.description: Directory for persistent JSON profile storage

fields.name: _memory
fields.description: In-memory cache layer keyed by canonical model name

types.description: File-based cache manager for model profiles with memory layer and pre-seeded fallback

functions.name: TaskRegisterProfile.best_register
functions.description: Returns the register with highest accuracy for this task type. Defaults to 'direct' if no accuracies available.
postconditions: Returns 'direct' if self.accuracies is empty
Otherwise returns the register field of the RegisterAccuracy with maximum accuracy

functions.name: TaskRegisterProfile.spread_pp
functions.description: Calculates percentage point spread (max - min accuracy) * 100 for this task type. Returns 0.0 if no accuracies.
postconditions: Returns 0.0 if self.accuracies is empty
Otherwise returns (max(accuracies) - min(accuracies)) * 100

functions.name: ModelProfile.spread_pp
functions.description: Calculates aggregate percentage point spread (max - min accuracy) * 100 across all registers. Returns 0.0 if no accuracies. Computed field.
postconditions: Returns 0.0 if self.accuracies is empty
Otherwise returns (max(accuracies) - min(accuracies)) * 100

functions.name: ModelProfile.is_invariant
functions.description: Determines if model is register-invariant (spread < 2.0 percentage points). Computed field.
postconditions: Returns True if self.spread_pp < 2.0, False otherwise

functions.name: ModelProfile.best_register
functions.description: Returns the aggregate register with highest accuracy. Defaults to 'direct' if no accuracies. Computed field.
postconditions: Returns 'direct' if self.accuracies is empty
Otherwise returns the register field of the RegisterAccuracy with maximum accuracy

functions.name: ModelProfile.worst_register
functions.description: Returns the aggregate register with lowest accuracy. Defaults to 'direct' if no accuracies. Computed field.
postconditions: Returns 'direct' if self.accuracies is empty
Otherwise returns the register field of the RegisterAccuracy with minimum accuracy

functions.name: ModelProfile.best_register_for_task
functions.description: Returns optimal register for specific task type. Falls back to aggregate best_register if task type not found in by_task.
postconditions: If task_type matches a TaskRegisterProfile in self.by_task, returns that profile's best_register
Otherwise returns self.best_register (aggregate)

functions.name: ModelProfile.spread_for_task
functions.description: Returns register spread for specific task type. Falls back to aggregate spread if task type not found.
postconditions: If task_type matches a TaskRegisterProfile in self.by_task, returns that profile's spread_pp
Otherwise returns self.spread_pp (aggregate)

functions.name: ModelProfile.is_expired
functions.description: Checks if profile has exceeded its TTL based on calibrated_at timestamp. Returns False if calibrated_at is empty or parsing fails.
postconditions: Returns False if self.calibrated_at is empty
Returns False if datetime parsing raises ValueError or TypeError
Otherwise returns True if (now - calibrated_at) > self.ttl_hours, False otherwise
side_effects: Calls datetime.now(timezone.utc) to get current time

functions.name: ProfileCache.__init__
functions.description: Initializes ProfileCache with optional cache directory. Defaults to ~/.transmogrifier/profiles if not provided.
postconditions: self._cache_dir is set to cache_dir if provided, otherwise Path.home() / '.transmogrifier' / 'profiles'
self._memory is initialized to empty dict

functions.name: ProfileCache.get
functions.description: Retrieves ModelProfile by name with alias resolution, memory cache, file cache, and pre-seeded fallback. Returns None if not found.

inputs.name: model_name
inputs.description: Model identifier (may be alias or canonical name)

postconditions: Resolves model_name via _ALIASES to canonical name
Returns cached unexpired profile from memory if exists
Otherwise loads from file, caches in memory, and returns if unexpired
Otherwise returns from _PRESEEDED dict if exact match exists
Otherwise returns from _PRESEEDED dict if partial match exists (key in canonical or canonical in key)
Returns None if no match found anywhere

functions.name: ProfileCache.put
functions.description: Persists ModelProfile to disk and updates memory cache. Creates cache directory if it doesn't exist.
postconditions: Creates self._cache_dir with parents if it doesn't exist
Writes profile JSON to {cache_dir}/{profile.model_name}.json
Updates self._memory[profile.model_name] with profile
Returns Path to written file

functions.name: ProfileCache.invalidate
functions.description: Removes profile from memory cache and deletes file from disk. Returns True if file was deleted, False otherwise.
postconditions: Resolves model_name via _ALIASES to canonical name
Removes canonical name from self._memory if present
Deletes {cache_dir}/{canonical}.json if it exists and returns True
Returns False if file does not exist

functions.name: ProfileCache.list_profiles
functions.description: Returns list of all available profiles from pre-seeded data and cached files, deduplicating by model_name.
postconditions: Returns list starting with all _PRESEEDED profiles
Appends profiles from {cache_dir}/*.json files that don't have matching model_name in pre-seeded
Silently skips files that fail to parse
side_effects: Reads all .json files from cache_dir if directory exists

functions.name: ProfileCache._load_file
functions.description: Internal method to load ModelProfile from JSON file. Returns None if file doesn't exist or parsing fails.
postconditions: Returns None if {cache_dir}/{model_name}.json does not exist
Returns ModelProfile instance if file exists and parses successfully
Returns None and logs debug message if parsing fails
side_effects: Logs debug message on parse failure

invariants: _PRESEEDED contains pre-calibrated profiles for 'claude-opus-4', 'claude-haiku-4-5', 'gpt-4o-mini', 'gemini-2-5-flash' as of 2026-03-27
_ALIASES maps versioned model IDs to canonical profile names
Default register fallback is always 'direct' when accuracies list is empty
Profile TTL default is 720 hours (30 days)
Register spread threshold for invariance is 2.0 percentage points
